 College basketball games today: Wednesday's exhibition schedule features St. John's, Auburn, LSU and more 
 Rick Pitino's Red Storm begin preseason action, Auburn meets Florida State in Birmingham, and LSU hosts UCF in an intriguing SEC-Big 12 matchup. By Rodney Knuppel | Oct 14, 2026, 10:01 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Rick Pitino | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect College basketball fans have another opportunity to see some of the nation's most interesting programs on Wednesday, October 14.
